_MAX_MODULE_ERROR = const(5)
_DNS_TIMEOUT_MS = const(500)
_DNS_TRIES = const(1)
_NTP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = const(5000)
_FIRMWARE_VERSION = const('2.0b0')
_WEBSITE_VERSION = const('2.0b0')
_BUILD_DATE = const('2026-10-06T19:32:00Z')

def _gmtimestruct_to_dict(t: "Any") -> "dict[str, int] | None":
    if t is None:
        return None
    return {"year": t[0], "month": t[1], "mday": t[2], "hour": t[3], "minute": t[4], "second": t[5], "weekday": t[6], "yearday": t[7]}

async def _flush_pending_configs() -> None:
    assert conn is not None
    assert ntp is not None
    assert sysfunct is not None
    assert scd30_a is not None
    assert scd30_b is not None
    assert fram is not None
    assert bmp3xx_only is not None
    assert sgp40_a is not None
    assert sgp40_b is not None
    assert neopixel is not None
    assert notification is not None
    assert webserver is not None
    for module in (conn, ntp, sysfunct, scd30_a, scd30_b, fram, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b, neopixel, notification, webserver,):
        cfgmgr = getattr(module, "cfgmgr", None)
        if cfgmgr is not None:
            await cfgmgr.flush_pending()

async def _system_cmd_callback(cmd: str) -> bool:
    assert sysfunct is not None
    if cmd == "reboot":
        await _flush_pending_configs()
        sysfunct.reboot_system()
    elif cmd == "bootloader":
        await _flush_pending_configs()
        sysfunct.reboot_bootloader()
    elif cmd == "mempause":
        sysfunct.pause_permanent_storage(300)
    else:
        return False
    return True

_FIELD_LED_R: "cm.FieldSchema" = ("r", "int", None, 0, 255, None)
_FIELD_LED_G: "cm.FieldSchema" = ("g", "int", None, 0, 255, None)
_FIELD_LED_B: "cm.FieldSchema" = ("b", "int", None, 0, 255, None)
_FIELD_LED_T: "cm.FieldSchema" = ("t", "float", None, 0.5, 60.0, None)

async def _notification_led_callback(payload: "dict[str, Any]") -> bool:
    assert neopixel is not None
    try:
        r_err, r = cm.type_or_range_error(payload["r"], _FIELD_LED_R)
        g_err, g = cm.type_or_range_error(payload["g"], _FIELD_LED_G)
        b_err, b = cm.type_or_range_error(payload["b"], _FIELD_LED_B)
        t_err, t = cm.type_or_range_error(payload["t"], _FIELD_LED_T)
    except KeyError:
        return False
    if r_err or g_err or b_err or t_err:
        return False
    return await neopixel.request_signal(r, g, b, t)

async def _notification_pause_callback(payload: int) -> bool:
    assert notification is not None
    await notification.set_override_led(payload)
    return True

async def _sgp_maintenance_status() -> "dict[str, Any]":
    assert sgp40 is not None
    backup_ts, restore_ts = await sgp40.get_mem_status()
    return {"BackupTS": backup_ts, "RestoreTS": restore_ts}

async def _networking_status() -> "dict[str, Any]":
    assert conn is not None and ntp is not None
    wifi_data = await conn.get_data()
    ifcfg = conn.get_wlan_ifconfig()
    ntp_data = await ntp.get_data()
    return {
        "WifiUptime": await conn.get_wifi_uptime(), "Mode": wifi_data.Mode, "Connected": wifi_data.Connected, "IP": wifi_data.IP,
        "IPv4": None if ifcfg is None else ifcfg[0], "Subnet": None if ifcfg is None else ifcfg[1],
        "Gateway": None if ifcfg is None else ifcfg[2], "DNS": None if ifcfg is None else ifcfg[3], "Rssi": conn.get_wlan_rssi(),
        "NtpSynced": ntp_data.Synced, "NtpLastSyncAge": ntp_data.LastSyncAge, "NtpLastSync": ntp_data.TS,
    }

async def _system_status() -> "dict[str, Any]":
    assert sysfunct is not None and ntp is not None
    local_time = await ntp.cettime()
    utc = time.gmtime() if await ntp.ntp_issynced() else None
    return {
        "SysUptime": await sysfunct.get_uptime(), "BootSignature": await sysfunct.get_boot_signature(),
        "MemPaused": fram.get_pause(),
        "LocalTime": _gmtimestruct_to_dict(local_time), "UtcTime": _gmtimestruct_to_dict(utc),
    }

async def _notification_status() -> "dict[str, Any]":
    assert notification is not None
    data = await notification.get_data()
    return {"Triggered": data.Triggered, "TS": data.TS, "PauseTime": await notification.get_override_led()}

async def build_system(
    *, cfg_path: str = "", debug: int | None = None, web_host: str = "0.0.0.0", web_port: int = 80
) -> None:
    """Construct every module and run the grouped setup() batch - generated, mirrors build_system()'s
    documented shape in every hand-written sensortask_*.py (SPECIFICATION.md Part A.7)."""
    global watchdog, i2c0, i2c1, spi0, conn, ntp, sysfunct, scd30_a, scd30_b, fram, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b, neopixel, notification, webserver, timers_running

    watchdog = WDT(timeout=8000)
    i2c0 = asy_i2c_driver.I2C(0, 13, 12, frequency=50000, timeout=200000)
    i2c1 = asy_i2c_driver.I2C(1, 19, 18, frequency=50000, timeout=200000)
    spi0 = asy_spi_driver.SPI(0, 2, 3, 4)
    log_ram = LogConfig(None, DEFAULT_LOG.history_length, debug)
    conn = AsyConnTime(WifiConfig('SensorStationMultiInstance', '12345678', 4, 9), ext_led=None, max_module_error=_MAX_MODULE_ERROR, cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_ram)
    ntp = AsyNtpClient(conn.get_wifi_mode_lock(), conn.network_available, conn.get_dns_server_ip, NtpTiming(_DNS_TIMEOUT_MS, _DNS_TRIES, _NTP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS, 10, 600), cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_ram)
    sysfunct = SystemService(ntp.ntp_issynced, watchdog=watchdog, storage=None, level_setters=_collect_level_setters, cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_ram)
    scd30_a = SCD30_Reader(i2c0, 8, trigger_sec=2, max_module_error=_MAX_MODULE_ERROR, name_ext='a', log=log_ram)
    scd30_b = SCD30_Reader(i2c1, 9, trigger_sec=5, max_module_error=_MAX_MODULE_ERROR, name_ext='b', log=log_ram)
    fram = AsyFramManager(spi0, 1, max_size=0x4000, log=log_ram)
    log_fram = LogConfig(fram, DEFAULT_LOG.history_length, debug)
    bmp3xx_only = BMP3xx_Reader(i2c0, address=0x76, max_module_error=_MAX_MODULE_ERROR, name_ext='only', cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_fram)
    sgp40_a = SGP40_Reader(i2c1, temperature=ValueRef(scd30_b, 'Temp'), humidity=ValueRef(scd30_b, 'Hum'), max_module_error=_MAX_MODULE_ERROR, name_ext='a', cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_ram)
    sgp40_b = SGP40_Reader(i2c0, temperature=ValueRef(bmp3xx_only, 'Temp'), humidity=ValueRef(_DefaultHumiditySource(relative_humidity=35), 'value'), max_module_error=_MAX_MODULE_ERROR, name_ext='b', cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_ram)
    neopixel = NeopixelDriver(15, log=log_ram)
    notification = NotificationCoordinator(_DefaultSignalSink().request_signal, ntp.cettime, signals=(NotificationSignal('WarnVOC', ValueRef(sgp40_a, 'VOC'), _FIELD_WARN_VOC, (0, 1, 0)),), cfg_path=cfg_path, log=log_ram)

    app = Microdot()
    webserver = WebserverService(
        app,
        routes=RouteSources(
            sensors=(scd30_a, scd30_b, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            settings={
                "networking": [
                    SettingsGroup(conn, ("SSID", "PW", "Country", "Hostname"), post_fct=conn.reconnect_wifi),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    SettingsGroup(conn, ("LedWifiOn",)),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    SettingsGroup(ntp, ("NTP_Host", "NTP_Offset_S", "NTP_Interv_H"), post_asy_fct=ntp.ntp_force_sync),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                ],
                "system": [
                    SettingsGroup(sysfunct, ("DebugLevel",)),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    SettingsGroup(ntp, ("GMTOffset", "DSTOffset")),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                ],
                "notification": [SettingsGroup(notification, cm.schema_names(notification.get_cfg_schema()))],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            },
            build_info={"firmwareVersion": _FIRMWARE_VERSION, "websiteVersion": _WEBSITE_VERSION, "buildDate": _BUILD_DATE},
            system_cmd=_system_cmd_callback,
            notification_led=_notification_led_callback,
            notification_pause=_notification_pause_callback,
            status_sources={"networking": _networking_status, "system": _system_status, "notification": _notification_status},
            maintenance_sensors=(("SGP40", _sgp_maintenance_status),),
            error_sources=_collect_error_sources(),
        ),
        serving=ServingLimits(
            max_content_length=2048,
            chunk_bytes=256,
            max_connections=6,
            backlog=None,
            per_call_timeout_s=5.0,
            outer_cap_s=15.0,
            host=web_host,
            port=web_port,
        ),
        static=StaticSite(mount="/html", index_file='index.html', is_hotspot_active=conn.is_hotspot_active),
        log=log_ram,
    )
    timers_running = ThreadSafeFlag()

    gc.collect()
    await fram.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await sysfunct.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await conn.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await ntp.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await bmp3xx_only.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await sgp40_a.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await sgp40_b.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()
    await notification.setup()
    sysfunct.feed_watchdog()
    gc.collect()

def _collect_error_sources() -> "list[Any]":
    assert conn is not None
    assert ntp is not None
    assert sysfunct is not None
    assert scd30_a is not None
    assert scd30_b is not None
    assert fram is not None
    assert bmp3xx_only is not None
    assert sgp40_a is not None
    assert sgp40_b is not None
    assert neopixel is not None
    assert notification is not None
    sources: list[Any] = []
    for module in (conn, ntp, sysfunct, scd30_a, scd30_b, fram, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b, neopixel, notification,):
        sources.extend(module.get_error_sources())
    return sources

def _collect_level_setters() -> "list[Callable[[int], None]]":
    assert webserver is not None
    setters: list[Callable[[int], None]] = []
    for module in (conn, ntp, sysfunct, scd30_a, scd30_b, fram, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b, neopixel, notification, webserver):
        setters.extend(logger.set_level for logger in module.get_loggers())
    return setters

def _collect_task_starters() -> "list[Callable[[], asyncio.Task[Any]]]":
    assert webserver is not None
    starters: list[Callable[[], asyncio.Task[Any]]] = []
    for module in (conn, ntp, sysfunct, scd30_a, scd30_b, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b, neopixel, notification, webserver):
        starters.extend(module.get_task_starters())
    return starters

def _collect_timer_starters() -> "list[Callable[[], None]]":
    assert webserver is not None
    starters: list[Callable[[], None]] = []
    for module in (conn, ntp, sysfunct, scd30_a, scd30_b, bmp3xx_only, sgp40_a, sgp40_b, neopixel, notification, webserver):
        starters.extend(module.get_timer_starters())
    return starters

async def main(*, cfg_path: str = "", debug: int | None = None, web_host: str = "0.0.0.0", web_port: int = 80) -> None:
    await build_system(cfg_path=cfg_path, debug=debug, web_host=web_host, web_port=web_port)
    assert sysfunct is not None and ntp is not None
    task_starters = _collect_task_starters()
    timer_starters = _collect_timer_starters()
    await sysfunct.start_timers(timer_starters)
    await ntp.ntp_force_sync()
    await sysfunct.start_and_check_tasks(task_starters)
